# .scratch/ is written by scratch-files.js from spec and map documents and their child tasks; edits…

.scratch/ is written by scratch-files.js from spec and map documents and their child tasks; edits read back by file hash as with ADRs; out of git through its own .scratch/.gitignore

- Only tasks with a spec or a map get `.scratch/<task>/`; spec.md and map.md are the documents' chaptered Markdown (Pocock's headings as chapters, anchors kept), read back with docs-sync's parseManaged.
- Tickets are the task's children: `issues/NN-slug.md` numbered in key order, with Status (open, claimed = active, resolved = done or dropped), Type and Blocked by (as NN) lines; Status and title are read back.
- A clash (file and database both changed) keeps the database and stores the file's text as a note.
- Git: a `.scratch/.gitignore` with `*` instead of touching the repo's .gitignore; removed when `{"scratch": {"commit": true}}`.
- Runs in sideFiles, so on every docs sync.
